senses.gloss: प्र-ग See under प्र-√ गम् below.
प्र-˚ग mfn. going before, preceding, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 38, Sch.
प्र-√ गा P. -जिगाति, to go forwards proceed, advance, move, go, RV.; MBh.
प्रगट w.r. for प्र-कट, HYog.
प्र-√ गण् P. -गणयति, to reckon up, calculate, MBh. (ind.p. -गणय्य, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 56, Sch.)
प्र-गणिका f. a female favourite of a king, L.
प्र-गण्ड m. the upper part of the arm (also ˚डक), L. (cf. प्र-काण्ड)
प्र-गण्डी f. an outer wall or rampart, MBh.
प्र-गदित mfn. (√ गद्) spoken, speaking, beginning to speak, W.
प्र-˚गाद्य mfn., Pāṇ. iii, 1, 100, Sch.
प्रा—गद्य mfn. (fr. -गदिन्), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80.
प्र-√ गम् P. -गच्छति (ep. also Ā. ˚ते), to go forwards, set out, advance, proceed, go to, reach, attain, RV.; &c.
प्र-˚गे ind. See below.
प्र-गे ind. early in the morning, at dawn, at day-break (‘when the sun goes forth’ ?), Lāṭy.; Mn. &c.
to-morrow morning, Siṃhās.
प्र-गे See under प्र-√ गम्.
प्र-˚गत mfn. gone forward, started, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
separate, apart (see below)
gone with difficulty, W.
प्र-˚गत—जानु mfn. having the knees far apart, bandy-legged, bow-legged, L.
प्र-˚गत—जानुक mfn. having the knees far apart, bandy-legged, bow-legged, L.
प्र-˚गम m. the first manifestation of love, first advance in courtship, Pratāp.
प्र-˚गमन n. = prec. Pāṇ. viii, 4, 34, Sch.
a speech containing an excellent answer, Sāh.
progress, advance, W.
difficult progress (?), ib.
disputing (?), ib.
प्र-˚गमनीय mfn., Pāṇ. viii, 4, 34, Sch.
प्र-˚गामन् n. walk, gait, step (see पृथु-ग्˚).
प्र-˚गामिन् mfn. setting out, being about to depart, R. (v.l. प्राग्-ग्˚).
प्राग्—गामिन् mfn. going before, preceding, intending to go before, R.
प्र-गे—तन mfn. (Pāṇ. iv, 3, 23) matutinal, early, Bālar.
relating to the next day, future, L.
प्र-गे—निश mfn. one who (sleeps) in the early morning as (if it were) night, MBh.
प्र-गे—शय mfn. asleep early in the morning, ib.
प्र-गयण n. an excellent answer, Daś. (w.r. for -गामन?)
(in dram.) a kind of dialogue, Bhar.
प्र-√ गर्ज् P. -गर्जति, to begin to thunder, MBh.
प्र-˚गर्जन n. roaring, roar (cf. सिंह-).
प्र-˚गर्जित n. a roar, noise, din, L.
प्र-गर्धि॑न् mfn. (√ गृध्) pressing or hastening onwards, eager, RV.
प्र-√ गल् Caus. -गालयति, to cause to fall off, Car.
प्र-˚गलित mfn. dripped down, Megh.
प्र-˚गल्भ mf(आ)n. bold, confident, resolute, brave, strong, able, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
proud, arrogant, impudent, Ragh.
skilful, Kād.
illustrious, eminent, W.
mature (as age), MW.
प्र-˚गल्भ m. N. of the fire employed at the Jātakarman, Gṛhyās.
(with आचार्य) N. of an author (called also Śubhaṃ-kara), Cat.
प्र-˚गल्भा f. a bold and confident woman (esp. one of the classes of heroines in dram. composition), Sāh.
N. of Durgā, L.
प्र-˚गल्भम् ind. courageously, resolutely, Mṛcch.
प्र-˚गल्भ—कुलाल m. a skilful potter, Bhartṛ.
प्र-˚गल्भ—ता f. (Kum.) boldness, wilfulness, resolution, energy, strength, power
प्र-˚गल्भ—त्व n. (W.) boldness, wilfulness, resolution, energy, strength, power
प्र-˚गल्भ—मनस् mfn. resolute-minded (अ-), Amar.
प्र-˚गल्भ—लक्षण n. N. of wk.
प्र-˚गल्भ—लक्षण-प्रकाश m. N. of wk.
प्र-˚गल्भ—वाच् mfn. speaking confidently or proudly, Kum.
प्र-˚गल्भित mfn. proud, arrogant, MW.
eminent, conspicuous, ib.
shining or resplendent with (instr.), Cat.
1.प्र-˚गाण n. (for 2. see under प्र-√ गै) access, approach, see पृथु-प्रग्˚.
2. प्र-˚गाण n. (for 1. See प्र-गा) singing, song, L.
प्र-गाढ &c. See प्र-√ गाह् below.
प्र-˚गाढ mfn. dipped or steeped in, mixed with, soaked, impregnated (ifc.), Suśr.
much, excessive, MBh.
rich in, full of (ifc.), Kām.
advanced, late (hour), Daś.
hard, difficult, L.
प्र-˚गाढ n. a crowd, MBh. iv, 1977 (= सं-कट, Nīlak.)
pain, privation, penance, W.
प्र-गाथ See प्र-√ गै, col. 2.
प्र-˚गाथ॑ m. a kind of stanza (the combination of a Bṛhatī or Kakubh with a Sato-bṛhatī so as to form a triplet), VS.; RPrāt. &c.
N. of a Ṛṣi with the patr. Kāṇva and Ghaura, the author of RV. viii, 1, 2; 10; 48; 51-54
(pl.) N. of RV. viii (which contains a great many Pr˚ stanzas)
प्रा—गाथ mf(ई)n. belonging to the Pragāthas (i.e. to, RV. viii), ĀśvŚr.
प्रा—गाथ m. patr. of Kali and Bharga and Haryata, RAnukr.
प्र-√ गाह् Ā. -गाहते, to dive into, penetrate, pervade, RV.
प्र-˚गाढम् ind. much, exceedingly, greatly, Kāv.; Suśr.
tightly, firmly, W.
प्र-˚गाढ—ता f. abundance, excessiveness, MW.
hardness, ib.
प्र-˚गाढ—त्व n. abundance, excessiveness, MW.
hardness, ib.
प्र-˚गाहन n. dipping or plunging into (gen.), ĀpŚr.
प्र-गीत ˚ति. See प्र-√ गै.
प्र-˚गीत mfn. recited in a singing tone, sung, Sarvad.
resonant with singing, vocal, MBh.; R.
singing, one who has begun to sing, Kathās.
प्र-˚गीत n. song, Ṛtus.; Caurap.
a sing-song or drawling recitation (regarded as a fault), Śikṣ.
प्र-गुण mf(आ)n. straight (lit. and fig.), right, correct, honest, upright, Mālatīm.; Hcar.
being in a good state or condition, excellent, Ragh.; Mālatīm.
प्राग्—गुण mfn. possessing any previously mentioned quality, RāmatUp.
प्र-गुण—रचना f. = next, Daśar.
प्र-˚गुणन n. putting straight, arranging, Mālatīm.

प्र-˚गुणय Nom. P. ˚यति, to put straight, set right, Dhanaṃj.;
to develop, exhibit, manifest, Nyāyam.
प्र-˚गुणित mfn. made even or smooth or straight, put in order properly arranged, Bālar.; Pañc.
प्र-˚गुणिन् mfn. smooth or even i.e. friendly towards (loc.), MBh.
प्र-गुणी in comp. for ˚गुण.
प्र-गुणी—करण n. putting straight, arranging properly, KātyŚr., Sch.
प्र-गुणी—√ भू to make one's self fit or ready for (dat.), Kuv.
प्रगुण्य mfn. more exceeding, excellent, W.
प्रा—गुण्य n. (fr. -गुण) right position or direction, Car.

प्र-√ गुप् Caus. -गोपयति, to protect, guard, Pañc.; Bhaṭṭ.;
to conceal, keep secret, Hcat.
प्र-˚गोपन n. protection, preservation, salvation, W.
प्र-√ गुर् (only aor. -गूर्त), to cry aloud, RV. i, 173, 2 (Sāy. ‘to make great efforts’).

प्र-√ 1. गॄ P. -गृणाति, to proclaim, announce to (loc.), RV. i, 152, 5;
to extol, praise, BhP.

प्र-√ गै P. -गायति (ep. also Ā. ˚ते), to begin to sing, sing, celebrate, praise, extol;
to sound, resound, RV.; MBh.; BhP.
प्र-˚गातृ m. a singer, MBh. (‘excellent singer’, L.)
प्र-˚गाथ—कारम् ind. combining into a Pr˚ stanza, Lāṭy.
प्र-˚गायिन् mfn. beginning to sing, singing, Hariv.
प्र-˚गीति f. a kind of metre, Col.
प्र-√ ग्रथ् P. -ग्रथ्नाति, or -ग्रथति, to string together, join, connect, Nyāyam., Sch.
प्र-˚ग्रथन n. connecting or stringing together, intertwining, Sāy.
प्र-√ ग्रस् P. -ग्रसति, to eat up, devour, swallow, MBh.
प्र-˚गृहीत mfn. held forth or out, taken, accepted &c., R.; Hariv. &c.
lofty, Divyāv.
joined, united with (ibc.), BhP.
kept separate, pronounced without observing the rules of Saṃdhi
प्र-˚गृहीत—पद mf(आ)n. having the words pronounced separately, RPrāt.
1. प्र-˚गृह्य mfn. to be seized or taken or accepted, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(in gram.) to be taken or pronounced separately, not subject to the rules of Saṃdhi (as the final ई, ऊ, and ए of the dual terminations, e.g. कवी एतौ, ‘these two poets’), Prāt.; Pāṇ. &c.
2. प्र-˚गृह्य ind. having taken or grasped, carrying away with, with, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्र-˚ग्रह m. (ifc. f(आ). ) holding in front, stretching forth, MBh.
seizing, clutching, taking hold of (˚हं गतः, seized, taken), ib.; Hariv.
a partic. manner of fighting, MBh. (= शत्रोर् उत्तानपा-तनार्थम् पादाकर्षणम्, or = गल-हस्तकः, Nīlak.)
the seizure of the sun or moon, beginning of an eclipse (cf. ग्रह), Sūryas.
friendly reception, kindness, favour, MBh.; Hariv.
obstinacy, stubbornness (˚हंगतः, obstinate, stubborn), MBh.
a rein, bridle, KaṭhUp.; MBh. &c.
a ray of light (like all words meaning ‘rein’ or ‘bridle’), L.
a rope, halter, cord, string, thong, MBh.
the cord or string suspending a balance, L.
a guide, leader, ruler (also as N. of Viṣṇu-Kṛṣṇa), MBh.
a companion, satellite, ib.
binding, L.
taming, breaking (a horse), L.
the arm, L.
a species of plant, Car. (Cassia Fistula, L.)
a vowel not subject to the rules of Saṃdhi, TPrāt. (-त्व n. Sch.; cf. 1. प्र-गृह्य)
N. of a partic. sacrificial rite (also -होम, KātyŚr., Sch.)
प्र-˚ग्रह mf(आ)n. receiving, kind, hospitable (with सभा f. a hall of reception, an audience hall), R. (B.)
प्र-˚ग्रह mf(आ)n. = ऊर्ध्वबाहु (?), R., Sch. (cf. प्र॑ञ्जलि-प्रग्र्˚)
प्र-˚ग्राह m. (only L.) seizing, taking, bearing, carrying (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 3, 46)
a rein, bridle (cf. ib. 53)
the string of a balance (cf. ib. 52)
प्र-˚ग्रह—त्व n., Sch.; cf. 1. प्र-गृह्य
प्र-˚ग्रह—वत् mfn. (ifc.) one who has seized, holding, MBh.
receiving, kindly, obliging, R. (Sch. ‘keeping down the wicked’ or ‘controlling the organs of sense’)
प्र-˚ग्राह—वत् mfn. having the string of a balance, MW.
प्र-˚ग्रहादि-दर्पण m. N. of wk.
प्र-˚ग्रहिन् mfn. guiding the reins, BhP.
प्र-˚ग्रहण m. a leader, guide (only ifc. [f(आ). ] ‘led by’), MBh.
stretching forth, offering, ŚāṅkhŚr.
taking, seizing, holding, ib.
the seizure of the sun and moon, commencement of an eclipse, VarBṛS.; Sūryas.
a means for taming or breaking in MBh.
the being a leader or guide, authority, dignity, ib.
a rein, bridle, MW.
a check, restraint, ib.
प्र-˚ग्रहीतव्य mfn. to be checked or controlled, Vajracch.
प्र-˚ग्राहम् ind. taking the words separately, not pronouncing them according to the rules of Saṃdhi, AitBr.
प्र-ग्रीव mfn. (g. अर्धर्चादि; also -क ifc. Hcar.) a wooden balustrade or fence round a building, Rājat. viii, 328
a window, lattice, balcony (projecting like a neck; cf. ग्रीवा), L.
a summer-house, pleasure-house, L.
a painted turret, L.
a stable, L.
the top of a tree, L.
प्राग्—ग्रीव mfn. having the neck turned eastward, GṛŚrS.; Kauś.

प्र-√ ग्लै P. -ग्लायति, to fade, wither away, Bhaṭṭ. (Sch. -म्लायति) :
Caus. -ग्लापयति, Vop.
प्र-˚ग्ल mfn. wearied, fatigued, exhausted, W.
प्रा—गल्भी f. (fr. गल्भ) boldness, confidence, resoluteness, determination, Bālar.
प्रा—गल्भ्य n. id., MBh.; Kāv. &c.
importance, rank, W.
manifestation, appearance, Kpr.
proficiency, MW.
प्रा—गल्भ्य—बुद्धि f. boldness of judgement, Pañcat.
प्रा—गल्भ्य—वत् mfn. possessed of confidence, bold, arrogant, Kathās.

प्राग˚हीय mfn. relating to Prāgahi, ib.
प्रागार m. or n. (?) a principal building, Inscr.
प्राग्र (प्र-अग्र) n. the highest point, summit, Nir.

प्राग्र्य mfn. chief principal, most excellent, MBh.; Hariv.
प्राग्राट n. thin coagulated milk, L.

प्राग्—अभिहित mfn. before mentioned
प्राग्—अभिहित—त्व n., Hcat.
प्राग्—अवस्था f. former state, a former condition of life, Rājat.; Sāy.
प्राग्—आयत mf(आ)n. extending east ward, ĀśvŚr.; MBh.
प्राग्—आहुति f. morning libation, ŚāṅkhGṛ. Comm.
प्राग्—आह्निक mfn. relating to the forenoon (= पौर्वाह्णिक), MBh.
प्राग्—उक्ति f. previous utterance, VPrāt., Sch.
प्राग्—उत्तर mf(आ)n. north-eastern, MBh.; Hariv.; R.
प्राग्—उत्तरा f. (with or scil. दिश्) the north-east, MBh.; R.

प्राग्—उत्तर—तस् ind. n˚-eastwards, to the north-east of (with abl. or gen.) [Var.]

प्राग्—उत्तर—दिग्-विभाग m. the n˚-eastern side of (gen.) (MBh.)

प्राग्—˚उदक्-प्लवन mfn. (MBh.; MārkP.) inclining towards the north-east

प्राग्—उद्˚अङ्-मुख mfn. having the face turned to the n˚-e˚ (or to the e˚ or n˚), Mn.; BhP.
प्राग्—उद्धार-संग्रह m. N. of wk.

प्राग्—गमन-वत् mfn. having a forward motion, going forwards, Vedāntas.
प्राग्—ग्रन्थि mfn. having the knots turned eastward, KātyŚr.

प्राग्—घुत, n. (KātyŚr.) or प्राग्—घोम, m. (प्राग्-होम, TBr. Comm.) a previous oblation.
प्राग्—घुत, n. (KātyŚr.) or प्राग्—घोम, m. (प्राग्-होम, TBr. Comm.) a previous oblation.
प्राग्—जन्मक mf(इका)n. belonging to a former life, HPariś. (इका f. = देवाङ्गना).
प्राग्—जन्मन् n. a former birth, f˚ life, BhP.; Kathās.; Rājat.

प्राग्—जात, n. (Bhartṛ.) or प्राग्—जाति, f. (Kathās.) id.

relating to the city of Prāg-jyotiṣa, MBh.
